Source Han Serif, also published as Noto Serif SC.
The license is OFL.txt in this folder (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

The font file is not stored in this repository. The app downloads
NotoSerifSC-Regular.otf, the Simplified Chinese subset, the first time
someone chooses the serif face, then keeps that file on the device.
The addresses are listed in lib/ui/songti_font.dart.
